About Binance
Binance is the global leading blockchain ecosystem, operating the world's largest digital asset trading platform by volume, serving over 300 million users across 100+ countries and regions. We are committed to building a more open financial ecosystem and improving global access to financial services.
Binance is continuously building stock and related financial market products for global users. The relevant data will serve user-facing stock products and Binance AI business scenarios. We are seeking professionals with stock market experience to jointly build reliable, scalable data and financial AI capabilities.

Role Overview
You will participate in building the core data foundation for Binance's stock and related financial market businesses, responsible for the full pipeline from data source discovery, evaluation, ingestion, and integration to unified modeling, real-time processing, quality governance, and data services. Beyond completing defined integrations, we expect you to leverage industry expertise to continuously identify better data sources and technical solutions, enabling new markets, products, and data to serve trading products and AI quickly and reliably.

Working at Binance
• Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow and offers excellent career development opportunities
• Work alongside diverse, world-class talent in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless
• Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects
• Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure
• Competitive salary and benefits
• Flexible working hours, remote-first, and casual work attire

Learn more about how Binancians embody the organization’s core values, creating a unified culture that enables collaboration, excellence, and growth.
Apply today to be a part of the Web3 revolution!
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research, technical evaluation, ingestion, integration, cleansing, standardization, computation, storage, and servicing of financial market data, covering securities master data, real-time and historical market data, fundamentals, corporate actions, indices, and business-required product and risk data; responsible for source ingestion, raw retention, and stable delivery to knowledge engineering pipelines for content-type data such as announcements, news, and research reports.
  • Design scalable unified data models and integration frameworks, handling different markets' trading calendars, time zones, currencies, security identifiers, listing relationships, lifecycles, and data corrections, supporting rapid onboarding of new markets and sources.
  • Build batch-stream unified data pipelines centered on Flink, continuously optimizing latency, throughput, query performance, stability, and cost, while supporting consumer trading products, research analysis, and AI scenarios.
  • Establish data quality and service level frameworks, taking responsibility for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and traceability; build automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, monitoring and alerting, raw data replay, backfill, and fault recovery capabilities.
  • Evaluate different sources (vendors, exchanges, APIs, file feeds, compliance collection) for coverage, quality, stability, revision mechanisms, and technical fit; collaborate with product, procurement, legal, and compliance teams to clarify usage, display, derivative, retention, and redistribution boundaries; drive rational primary/backup source strategies and alternatives.
  • Define data semantics, metric definitions, and service contracts jointly with trading product, data platform, AI engineering, and algorithm teams, ensuring consistent and reliable usage of the same stock facts across different products.
  • Drive data engineering efficiency and technical quality improvements, including metadata, data lineage, automated testing, CI/CD, task orchestration, capacity governance, and AI-assisted development.



Requirements

  • Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field; 5+ years of experience in data development, big data, or data platforms.
  • Familiar with stock markets and the investor research and decision-making workflow; understand trading mechanisms, market data, fundamentals and financial reports, corporate actions, valuation, and major market events; able to explain the complete pipeline of at least one type of financial data from source to user-facing product and key quality risks.
  • Proficient in SQL and Flink, with experience in large-scale real-time data processing, performance tuning, stability governance, and production issue troubleshooting.
  • Proficient in at least one of Java, Scala, or Python; familiar with Kafka, Spark, and ClickHouse, Doris, HBase, Elasticsearch, or other distributed storage and analytics technologies.
  • Familiar with data modeling, task scheduling, metadata, data lineage, data governance, and service levels; able to independently resolve cross-system data consistency issues.
  • High standards for data quality; able to design reproducible reconciliation, anomaly detection, backfill, and degradation strategies — not just completing data development tasks.
  • Experience with data source selection or production ingestion; able to articulate trade-offs between build vs. buy, multi-source verification, vendor dependency, and alternative solutions.
  • Strong business understanding and cross-team collaboration skills; able to translate trading, risk, research, or AI problems into clear data models and data contracts.

Bonus

  • Experience with stock data at brokerages, market data services, financial data, wealth management, or fintech platforms.
  • Familiarity with US stock market structure, trading calendars, pre/post-market sessions, corporate actions, and adjustment rules; experience with other stock markets also a plus.
  • Data experience with stock-related derivatives, ETFs, indices, or tokenized products.
  • Experience building low-latency market data pipelines, securities master data platforms, multi-market data models, quantitative research platforms, or large-scale backtesting data systems.
  • Experience with data anomaly detection, knowledge graphs, financial entity alignment, or building high-quality financial datasets for LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

About the Team: We build and run fiat on/off-ramp integrations. We connect with banks and payment providers around the world and support the core money flows: deposits, withdrawals and trading. We also connect these flows with our internal ledger and reconciliation systems. Our goal is that every transaction is secure, accurate and fully traceable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Fund Security: Design fund security for deposit, withdrawal and trading flows. Find where funds could be lost, and build controls that prevent problems up front, block them in real time and catch them afterwards.
  • Account Security: Design and build account security controls, such as account status management, fund freezing and unfreezing, protection for sensitive operations, and detection of abnormal behavior.
  • Channel Integration: Integrate with banks and third-party payment providers. Make callbacks, status sync, idempotency and retries reliable, so there are no duplicate credits, missed transactions or mismatched states.
  • Ledger Integration: Work with the internal accounting and clearing & settlement systems so that fund flows always match the ledger. Help design the accounting model and fund-flow standards.
  • Reconciliation: Build channel, internal and multi-party reconciliation. Handle break detection, suspense accounts and adjustments, and make sure every discrepancy gets resolved. Keep making reconciliation more automated and faster.
  • Monitoring & Incident Response: Build reconciliation checks and fund-loss alerts. Lead the investigation, containment and post-mortem for fund-related incidents.
  • AI Enablement: Use LLMs and AI tools to make fund security and reconciliation more efficient, for example anomaly detection, automatic root-cause analysis of breaks, smart reconciliation and operations support.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years in financial services (payments, banking, exchanges, etc.) with strong hands-on experience in fund security and reconciliation.
  • Expert Java skills, with a solid grasp of the JVM, concurrency and distributed systems. Deep understanding of high-availability, strongly consistent systems.
  • Skilled with the open-source Java stack, such as Spring Boot / Spring Cloud, MyBatis, MySQL, Redis and Kafka / RocketMQ, and understands how these tools work inside.
  • Experienced with distributed transactions, idempotency and eventual consistency. Has designed and shipped financial systems from start to finish.
  • Knows clearing & settlement processes and double-entry bookkeeping. Familiar with how banks integrate: APIs, SFTP reconciliation files, ISO 20022 / SWIFT messages.
  • Strong AI skills: Uses AI tools every day to work faster, with hands-on experience building LLM applications (prompt engineering, RAG, agents).
  • Strong sense of risk and close attention to detail. Takes ownership, communicates well and drives work forward.
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Role: As the digital-asset industry continues to evolve, so does the sophistication of identity fraud, deepfake attacks and AI-generated content. To stay ahead of emerging threats, Binance Risk is investing heavily in advanced computer vision and AI-driven identity verification technologies to protect our users and strengthen platform security.

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist with strong expertise in computer vision, particularly in deepfake detection, face anti-spoofing, facial animation detection, video manipulation detection and video analysis, to join our Risk AI team.

You will research, develop and deploy advanced AI models to detect face spoofing, deepfakes, manipulated videos and other sophisticated identity attacks. You will work on challenging real-world problems involving facial recognition, liveness detection, video understanding and generative AI, translating cutting-edge research into scalable production solutions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Research, design and develop advanced computer vision and deep learning models to detect sophisticated identity attacks, including face spoofing, deepfakes, face swapping, face animation, AI-generated faces and videos, and other emerging manipulation techniques.
  • Explore state-of-the-art image and video modeling techniques, including Vision Transformers (ViTs), multimodal models and vision-language models (VLMs), to improve fraud detection capabilities.
  • Explore how LLMs, agents, graph learning and anomaly detection can be applied to risk scenarios, including automated investigation, risk reasoning and real-time monitoring.
  • Build and optimize end-to-end machine learning pipelines, handling large-scale datasets, noisy labels, model training, evaluation and deployment, while improving model accuracy, robustness and inference efficiency.
  • Collaborate with KYC, backend engineering, risk operations and strategy teams to deploy scalable AI solutions into production systems.
  • Stay current with advances in computer vision, video understanding and generative AI, proactively identifying emerging fraud patterns and translating research breakthroughs into effective risk control solutions.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong expertise in computer vision and deep learning, particularly in face recognition, face anti-spoofing, deepfake detection, facial animation detection or video understanding.
  • Solid understanding of modern deep learning architectures, including CNNs, Vision Transformers (ViTs), multimodal models and video-based models.
  • Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, with hands-on experience in model training, fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • Experience handling large-scale image and video datasets, including data preprocessing, noisy labels, data augmentation and model performance analysis.
  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production, with a focus on accuracy, robustness, scalability and inference efficiency.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to independently drive complex AI projects.

Nice to Haves:

  • Extensive experience in biometric authentication, liveness detection, deepfake detection, video forgery detection or adversarial machine learning.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, VLMs, agents, knowledge distillation, self-supervised learning or generative AI technologies.
  • Experience with large-scale ML infrastructure, distributed training, GPU optimization (TensorRT, ONNX, CUDA) or cloud platforms such as AWS SageMaker.
